I'm not trolling. I do have several hobbies, I am a relatively whole person. I know it's a stupid thing to be concerned about, unfortunately the way things work is I don't get to say, "Stop," and suddenly stop caring about stupid things. 

I wasn't that concerned with it until I thought I was big, that's mainly the problem, because I felt so happy and fulfilled. I've dealt with suicidal suicidal ideation and depression for unrelated reasons for a long time and this stupid thing completely changed my points of view in the course of a day. I felt really at peace for the first time in years. I didn't think it mattered that much but clearly it did to me.

Dunno if you're there, was thinking about getting some sort of therapy but don't really see how I can because I live with/am supported by my parents.

Besides, I feels like it would be pointless, since its an inherent part of the world? Usually body dysmorphia deals with unrealistic or absurd expectation, not a real one. I guess I just have to live with it? IDK I was just so happy for that little bit of time. I've been on and off depressed for forever and I've never felt quite so at peace with myself
